title: Owner permits bounded system-level actions for the remaining macOS checks
context: After the macOS run, the owner asked why several checks were left as hand checks and asked for full end-to-end coverage "with my permission to perform tasks as necessary on the computer". The hand checks came from the thread's rules (no system-wide input after the 2026-09-24 freeze; ask before system settings or permission prompts) and from a tooling gap (the plain build has no in-app input and its Settings screen is invisible to accessibility).
options: Keep the checks as owner hand checks
Accessibility-only actions (answer the app's permission prompts, Finder copy and menus via AX)
System settings changed and restored (VoiceOver plus its AppleScript control, dark mode, Japanese input)
Short capped real-input bursts (HID-level pointer and key events) for Finder drag, Edit-menu mouse pick, accented and IME typing
Recording the app's audio output to confirm sound
outcome: Owner granted all four on 2026-09-27 via the permissions question: accessibility-only actions, system settings restored, short real-input bursts, audio recording. Conditions stated with the grant and binding on the run: act only after 20 s of owner idle, watchdog armed and still stopping on owner input, every changed setting restored afterwards, each real-input burst capped with modifiers pressed only inside a single chord and always released. This scopes an exception to decision 01M3AT28FWNM2HGCKS2R4SYKPG (live-test input never leaves the device under test) for the remaining macOS checks only; it does not make system-wide input the default.
